validity.recommendation: Keep Diameter blank on the Kelso-Beaver Reliability Project row (and keep LengthKnownKm at 0.00) -- do not carry the gem.wiki system infobox figure of '24 in; 30 in' onto this project. FERC Docket Nos. CP25-89-000/CP25-90-000 establish that Northwest Pipeline is ACQUIRING an already-existing 18-mile, 20-inch-diameter line (the KB Pipeline, abandoned to Northwest by PGE/KB Pipeline Co./B-R Pipeline in CP25-90-000), converting it to bi-directional service behind one new 5,500-hp electric compressor station. Both FERC's own scoping notice and Williams' own project fact sheet -- two independent publishers -- state the facility list is limited to the new compressor station plus modification of the existing KB meter station, and the fact sheet says outright 'No new pipelines are proposed in this project.' No new pipe is laid, so per the standing expansion rule (no new physical pipe -> LengthKnown=0, Diameter=blank) the blank Diameter is the correct, confirmed value, not a gap to fill.
validity.researcher_notes: Read FERC's scoping notice (Docket CP25-89/CP25-90, 90 FR 17058-17060, FR Doc 2025-06944, 2025-04-23) and EA-availability notice (90 FR 41828-41829, FR Doc 2025-16410, 2025-08-27) via the Federal Register raw-text API (the HTML page itself redirects behind an unblock wall), plus Williams' 'Kelso Beaver Reliability Project' fact sheet PDF (downloaded, read with pdftotext -layout). Scoping notice, quoted verbatim: 'Northwest proposes to acquire, own, and operate an existing 18-mile-long, 20-inch-diameter pipeline (KB Pipeline) from Portland General Electric Company, KB Pipeline Company, and B-R Pipeline, LLC ... Portland General Electric Company, KB Pipeline Company, and B-R Pipeline, LLC also filed to abandon the KB Pipeline to Northwest in Docket No. CP25-90-000.' Williams fact sheet, quoted verbatim: 'The project includes a new compressor station, modifications and upgrades to an existing meter station. No new pipelines are proposed in this project.' Scope of Work on the same fact sheet lists 'Acquisition of existing FERC regulated Kelso Beaver pipeline' as the first bullet. The EA-availability notice's own facility list (one new KB Compressor Station; modification of the existing KB Meter Station) independently confirms no new line pipe. Note the existing KB Pipeline itself is 20-inch, which does not match the wiki's '24 in; 30 in' figure either -- that figure describes other segments of the wider Northwest Gas Pipeline system, not this acquisition project, reinforcing that it should not be carried onto this row regardless. Both URLs verified OK via scripts/url_verifier.py.
